mentions.name: Bossa Nova Chords
mentions.description: This web app displays manually curated bossa nova guitar chords synced with the songs' YouTube videos, offering a fun way to play along and learn the names of complex chord voicings. All chords were added by hand; the UI was built with the help of an AI model.
mentions.problem: The author had long wanted to share the chords of bossa nova songs he learned by ear in a fun way, but had zero front-end skills and little time to build it himself.
mentions.audience: Guitarists and bossa nova hobbyists who want to learn songs and chord voicings by playing along
mentions.source_excerpt: Now with the help of a model I created a nice webapp that syncs the chords with their youtube videos (the chords were all manually added, only the UI was vibecoded).
mentions.author: diehunde
